title.en: TRESPASS ON ROYAL PROPERTY ACT ORDER 2014

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-52-2014-TRESPASS-ON-ROYAL-PROPERTY-ACT-ORDER-2014.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Trespass on Royal Property Act (Amendment) of section 3 of Chapter 23.

Section 3 of the Trespass on Royal Property Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is amended by deleting "2 years and a fine of $2,000" from the last line and by substituting "a term of not less than 2 years and not more than 7 years and with whipping with J?-Ot less than 2 strokes" therefor. of section 4.

Section 4 of the Act is amended - (aj by deleting "sections 443 to 446 inclusive" from the third and fourth and by substituting "sections 443, 444, 445 and 446" therefor; (bj by deleting "sections 449 to 460 inclusive" from the penultimate line and by substituting "sections 448A, 449, 450, 451, 452, 453, 453A, 454, 455, 456, 456A, 457, 458, 459 and 460" therefor. of Schedule to Chapter 4.

The Schedule to the Interpretation and General Clauses Act is amended by inserting "Section 3 of the Trespass on Royal Property Act (Chapter 23)." immediately after "Section 29 of the Misuse of Drugs Act (Chapter 27).". Made this 12th. day of Zulhijjah, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of October, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
